entity.summary: Japanese centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched in August 2016 and later operated alongside Zaif under Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange Inc. before the two exchanges were integrated into Zaif on February 12, 2020.
entity.notes: FISCO first-party releases establish an exact 2016-08-29 exchange-operation start and an exact 2020-02-12 integration into Zaif. The September 2020 operating-company rename to Zaif Inc. is later corporate history and is not used as the exchange terminal date. Zaif itself pre-existed and continued, so HEI records this as a one-way terminal successor relationship rather than forcing Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange as Zaif's sole predecessor.

events.title: Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange began bitcoin exchange operations
events.description: FISCO announced that group company Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange Inc. had commenced operation of its bitcoin exchange, with bitcoin and monacoin trading available through fcce.jp.
events.notes: The exact launch date is supported by FISCO's dated operating-start announcement and its 2016 news archive.

events.title: Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange merged into Zaif Exchange
events.description: Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange Inc. completed the integration of its two exchanges, Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange and Zaif Exchange, into a single exchange at noon on February 12, 2020, after which former Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange users were directed to Zaif.
events.notes: This is the terminal lifecycle event for the standalone Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange service. Zaif continued operating.

evidence.title: Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange Begins Bitcoin Exchange Operations
evidence.notes: First-party English release states that Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange commenced bitcoin exchange operations on August 29, 2016 and identifies the historical fcce.jp exchange URL.

evidence.title: FISCO 2016 news release archive
evidence.notes: FISCO's 2016 news archive independently lists the August 29, 2016 start of bitcoin exchange operations.

evidence.title: Completion of integration of Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange and Zaif Exchange
evidence.notes: First-party integration notice states that Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange and Zaif Exchange were integrated into one exchange at 12:00 on February 12, 2020 and directs former Fisco users to Zaif.

evidence.title: FISCO corporate history
evidence.notes: FISCO corporate history records the February 2020 integration of Fisco Cryptocurrency Exchange and Zaif Exchange and separately records the September 2020 corporate-name change to Zaif Inc.
